paper.title_en: Chronology violation on locally finite quasiordered sets
paper.abstract_en: Classical causal set theory models spacetime causality by locally finite partial orders. Because partial orders are antisymmetric, they cannot represent distinct elements that are mutually causally related, as would occur in a discrete analog of a chronology-violating region. We develop a locally finite discrete framework that allows closed causal loops and yields a locally finite partial order upon identifying mutually related elements. Each class of mutually related elements is collapsed to one point in the induced poset, and its cardinality is assigned as a finite weight to the corresponding point. Within this setting we define maximum causal time using simple finite paths and prove an equidistance characterization: members of one chronology-violating class have the same discrete proper-time distance from any event in their common past or future, with a finite correction for the closed path inside the class. We also study the special case in which the relation is generated by iterating a single self-map <math display="inline"><mi>f</mi><mo>:</mo><mi>X</mi><mo stretchy="false">→</mo><mi>X</mi></math>; cycles of <math display="inline"><mi>f</mi></math> then give explicit finite closed causal loops. Finally, we define two finite counting invariants: the proportion of elements in chronology-violating classes and the normalized mean of <math display="inline"><mo stretchy="false">|</mo><mi>I</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo stretchy="false">|</mo><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></math>. We study the mathematical properties of these discrete causal structures; no equations of motion or probabilities for their occurrence are specified. The construction does not assert a continuum-discrete correspondence in the chronology-violating case, and ordinary causets are recovered when all equivalence classes are singletons.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 在因果集框架下构造允许闭合因果环的局部有限准序集，并证明等距刻画与给出有限计数不变量，属于离散因果结构的基础性数学工作，理论深度与概念新意适中，值得点击阅读以评估其构造与证明细节。
decision.title_zh: 局部有限准序集上的年表违反
decision.abstract_zh: 经典因果集理论用局部有限偏序来建模时空因果性。由于偏序是反对称的，它无法表示彼此相互因果相关的不同元素，而这种情形会出现在年表违反区域的离散类比中。我们发展了一个局部有限离散框架，该框架允许闭合因果环，并在将相互关联的元素等同之后给出一个局部有限偏序。每个相互关联元素的类在诱导偏序集中被坍缩为一个点，其基数被赋予为该对应点的一个有限权重。在此设定下，我们用简单有限路径定义最大因果时间，并证明一个等距刻画：同一个年表违反类的成员相对于其共同过去或未来中的任一事件具有相同的离散固有时距离，并带有一项来自该类内部闭合路径的有限修正。我们还研究了该关系由迭代单个自映射<math display="inline"><mi>f</mi><mo>:</mo><mi>X</mi><mo stretchy="false">→</mo><mi>X</mi></math>生成的特殊情形；此时<math display="inline"><mi>f</mi></math>的循环给出显式的有限闭合因果环。最后，我们定义了两个有限计数不变量：年表违反类中元素所占的比例，以及<math display="inline"><mo stretchy="false">|</mo><mi>I</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>,</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo stretchy="false">|</mo><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></math>的归一化均值。我们研究这些离散因果结构的数学性质；未指定其运动方程或出现概率。该构造并不断言在年表违反情形下存在连续—离散对应关系，而当所有等价类均为单元素集时，可恢复普通的因果集。
